title: Seedream joins the image models
summary:
Seedream, simpler text URLs, and copyable publishable keys led the day, with clearer tier information and four community projects added to the list.

ByteDance ARK Seedream 4.0 was added for Nectar-tier image generation, with a configured maximum side length of 2048 pixels. Image model metadata was also corrected for kontext and turbo, alongside an image-service start-script fix.

A new GET text-generation endpoint accepts a prompt in the URL and an optional model parameter. Enter also added copyable publishable API keys, fixed their authentication, and added support for using them in GET text and image URLs via the `key` query parameter.

The tier panel now displays revised daily Pollen amounts for Seed, Flower, and Nectar and explains refill timing and carryover. It also adds guidance for users seeing different tiers across accounts. The balance area and FAQ gained a link to vote on payment methods.

highlights.title: Seedream 4.0 added
highlights.text: Generate images with ByteDance ARK Seedream 4.0 on the Nectar tier, with a configured maximum side length of 2048 pixels. [Find Seedream](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=seedream).

highlights.title: Text generation by URL
highlights.text: Send a prompt to the new GET text-generation endpoint, with an optional `model` parameter when you want something other than the default. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Copyable publishable keys
highlights.text: Create a publishable API key in Enter, then return to the dashboard to view and copy it. [Manage API keys](https://enter.pollinations.ai/keys).

highlights.title: Keys in GET URLs
highlights.text: Authenticate GET text and image generation URLs with a publishable key in the `key` query parameter. Secret keys still require the Authorization header. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
